notes.title: Update v1.0.18
notes.notes:
This update contains a handful of updates and fixes. There has also been some groundwork lain for a possible mobile build of the game. 


 Fixed game crash when switching warp level in non-Steam versions of the game
 Fixed final cutscene sequence restarting when accessing the menu from end game score screen
 Fixed soft-lock when QBob was abducted at the same time as a grenade

notes.title: Update v1.0.16
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has played QBob: Remastered during its first week on Steam!

We've had a couple feature requests which have been included in this update. The most requested one we've added was the ability to jump right back into the game without having to navigate back to the main menu.

If you have any more suggestions, start a discussion and we'll take a look!

Here are the changes in this update:

Added

Players can now restart the game immediately from the game over menu without having to return to the splash screen

Added a help message if player jumps off asteroid telling them that in EASY mode, QBob can't fall off

Changed

Level warps no longer limited to post intermission levels. Start the game from any level that you've reached!

Demo version now also allows players to start game at any demo level they have reached

Start button remembers starting level of previous game

Chaser idle times for EASY and NORMAL lowered just a tad

Fixed

Hubcap no longer stalls after attacking the leftmost cube

ESC now checks for transition layer on High Score screen

notes.title: Update v1.0.15
notes.notes:
This will be the final update before launch day this Thursday the 24th at 12 noon CST. Excitement is building!

Added
Steam screenshot capability added!
Changed
XBob on 13, 14 and 19 reduced pursue range for easy mode players

Green cubes changed to blue on level 14 because they were hard to distinguish compared to yellow

Slaughter Rule disables any active cheats

UFO and Probe escape asteroid 3 seconds before detonation
Fixed
Fixed Level 20 head bounce glitch due to resized hitbox on QBob

ESC now correctly exits high the score screen

A few high score screen interaction tweaks when a dialog prompt appears

Menu buttons disabled if room is in the process of transitioning

notes.title: Update v1.0.13
notes.notes:
We've made some modifications to the difficulty level:

UFO, Probe and XBob movement speed reduced a tad

Easy mode now offers 4 lives at the start of the game

Easy mode shield lasts 12.5 seconds instead of 9.5

Easy self-destruct timer lasts a couple seconds longer

Player and enemy hit box sizes reduced a few pixels to make collisions a little more forgiving

notes.title: Update v1.0.11
notes.notes: A tiny update that fixes some intermission animations and some game meta info in the new Mac builds.

notes.title: Update v1.0.10
notes.notes:
After much work we finally have QBob: Remastered running on MacOS and Ubuntu Linux! In theory, Ubuntu support also means that the game should run natively on Steam Deck! Take that with a grain of salt though: we don't own a Steam Deck and are unable to test it out for ourselves.

Some other tweaks in this latest update:

Some more control fixes, including an annoying Paintgun glitch

Added some more Paintgun sounds

QBob grunts if he's caught in the explosion (grunting fans rejoice!)

We've published an online manual and it's fantastic!

QBob: Remastered Manual (PDF)

notes.title: Update v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Gamepad rumble support added with ability to turn it off in settings. Work in progress.

Hubcap abduction soft-lock bug: An extremely rare bug which has plagued the game for months has finally been squashed! ːsteamhappyː

Gamepad menu navigation improved: B BUTTON now backs you out of the menus, instructions, and high score screens.

Meteors now are properly z-indexed when spawning on a cube lower than the player's position.

notes.title: Update v1.0.4
notes.notes:
Gamepad ACTION button responsiveness enhanced

Gamepad analog stick deadzone bug fixed

Checks to make sure demo version doesn't alter high scores for full game

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Steam has approved QBob: Remastered for release! We have set the official release date and time to Thursday, July 24th at noon CST! 

Here are some of the updates included in this latest patch:

We've added checks that will allow us to create a demo version of QBob: Remastered. More on this soon!

Better gamepad support (as per Valves's review suggestions):

In theory, XBox "Home" button should trigger Steam overlay on some XBox controllers

Game can now detect if you are actively using a gamepad. If gamepad is in use, the in-game help prompts and dialogues will reflect gamepad controls

High score name entry with left stick added

MoonRock logo is skippable with any button press

If gamepad connection is lost whilst actively playing game, game will pause

Triggering Steam Overlay will pause an in-progress game

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
No sooner did we send version 1.0 out that we discovered a game crashing bug in the level set-up code.

Turns out that deprecated code that I removed did a bit more that I thought it did. Never fear though, I have replaced the suspect code and squashed this bug!

notes.title: Pre-Release Patch v0.102.0
notes.notes:
We're getting very close to the final build of QBob: Remastered!

Here are some of the updates that are included in this patch:

More refined meteor collisions allowing for QBob to escape death in some rare edge cases

XBob will no longer spawn on a telepad if QBob is in the process of teleporting IN to that same pad

Level 17 easy mode is now even easier!

Sound levels tweaked on level 20 to make boss louder

Grenade painting bug fixed when destroying a meteor or Roswell

A few other random balancing changes regarding power-up timing
